items.description:
Computer Mania Kolonnade Shopping Centre, next to Capitec Bank at Shop 7, Entrance 1, sells laptops, gaming and desktop PCs, PC components, monitors, peripherals and accessories, alongside printers, gaming consoles and accessories, smart home devices and software licences. Its CM Flex membership gives regular shoppers ongoing deals, and the store's Reboot programme lets customers buy pre-owned, certified devices or trade in their own equipment.

The branch also offers technical services and takes part in community involvement initiatives alongside its retail operation, reflecting a wider store network with its own warranty registration and terms. Open Monday to Friday from 9am to 7pm and Saturdays from 9am to 6pm, Computer Mania Kolonnade suits shoppers in Montana and Pretoria East wanting new, pre-owned or trade-in technology with warranty support and in-store technical help.

items.description:
CorruPack, in Hennopspark, started in 2017 from a vision to give the industrial sector and the general public a simple packaging solution, acting as an intermediary between volume-driven manufacturers and end-users. That position lets the company offer competitive prices while still accommodating small-quantity orders that larger manufacturers would otherwise turn away, backed by staff with more than 12 years of experience in the packaging industry.

The business runs weekly package deals on its top-selling products, and has combined its most popular items into box combos and moving kits that bundle boxes, wrapping materials and accessories for anyone relocating. Its range also covers adhesives and tapes, cleaning products, and corrugated board, die-cut and standard boxes. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, CorruPack suits households moving home as much as businesses needing an ongoing, cost-effective packaging supplier.

Cosmo Industrial, in Silverton, supplies welding equipment and consumables, gas welding and cutting gear, gasses, safety equipment, fasteners, generators, air and high-pressure cleaning equipment, gas appliances and general hardware and power tools, with a second branch in Jet Park, Johannesburg. Alongside retail, the company runs the Cosmo Training Academy, offering a five-day Basic Welder course, an International Welder course, a Practical Welder course and a one-day Product and Application training session.

Its consulting arm supports businesses with ISO 3834 system implementation, subcontracted welding coordination, welding procedure development (PQR and WPS), welder performance qualification and data book compilation, services aimed at companies that need to formalise their welding quality systems rather than just buy equipment. Based in Silverton, Pretoria, Cosmo Industrial suits both individual welders seeking training and companies needing welding equipment, consumables or compliance support under one roof.

CRC Clothing & Branding, in Rosslyn, manufactures custom sublimated and embroidered apparel including t-shirts, polo shirts, vests, hoodies, tracksuits, cycling jerseys, baseball jerseys and jackets, football and rugby kits, netball dresses, shorts and windbreakers. Items are available in sizes from XS to 8XL, with a minimum order of 15 units per design and starting prices from around R170 for vests up to R550 for a baseball jersey.

The company handles design in-house, making it suited to sports clubs, schools and corporate clients wanting matching branded kit rather than a one-off printed garment. Open Monday to Friday from 7am to 4pm, CRC Clothing & Branding operates from Rosslyn, Pretoria, and suits teams and businesses placing bulk orders for custom sportswear or branded clothing rather than individuals wanting a single item.

Crux Pharmaceuticals, established in 2007 and based in Garsfontein, is a registered and licensed South African pharmaceutical company that helps clients launch medicines, supplements, consumer health products and medical devices in the local market. Its end-to-end service runs from developing a business plan through to a fully established company, reducing both the cost and the timelines a client would face launching alone or acting purely as an advisor.

Services include sales and marketing of these products, drug safety and pharmacovigilance work, and broader business services such as market analysis, identifying opportunities, product and price analysis, distribution and business development. The practice operates against the backdrop of South Africa's pharmaceutical regulations, revised since 1994 to create a more tightly regulated environment. Based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, Crux Pharmaceuticals suits international pharmaceutical and medical device companies entering the South African market for the first time.

Dalein Agriplan, based in Leeuwfontein, designs and manufactures modular feed mills built for the African environment, with a large variety of feed milling options that can be adapted to a client's specific operation. Its offering extends beyond the mill itself to auxiliary processing and handling equipment used in related processes such as soya extrusion and oil extraction, serving the wider feed and agricultural manufacturing sector across Southern Africa and the rest of the continent.

Factory types the company builds for include compound feed operations, grain storage and handling facilities, and soya processing plants, supported by raw material storage systems such as bulk intake systems, bunkers and silos, and conveying equipment including chain conveyors, bucket elevators, augers and belt conveyors. Based in Leeuwfontein, Pretoria, Dalein Agriplan suits feed producers and agricultural processors needing a mill designed and built specifically for African operating conditions rather than an imported standard design.

items.description:
Dawie Coetzer Attorneys, based in Boardwalk Office Park, Faerie Glen, is a labour law and commercial law practice offering both employers and employees guidance on employment contracts and negotiations, disciplinary hearings and arbitrations, unfair and constructive dismissal claims, Labour Court litigation, CCMA and Bargaining Council matters, and retrenchment and redundancy processes. The firm also handles employment equity and discrimination matters and general workplace disputes.

On the commercial side, Dawie Coetzer Attorneys assists with company formations and regulations, shareholder agreements and dispute resolution, commercial contract negotiations and drafting, mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures and partnerships, and corporate governance and compliance. Based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, the firm suits employers and employees needing specialist labour law representation as well as businesses needing support on the commercial and corporate side of running a company.

Debt Success, based in Eloffsdal, is a debt counselling and debt review practice built around the idea that every client's financial story is unique and deserves a tailored roadmap back to financial freedom. The team negotiates directly with credit providers on a client's behalf under the formal debt review process, aiming to drastically reduce monthly repayments rather than simply consolidating debt into a single new loan.

Once a client is under debt review, their assets are protected from repossession and legal action from creditors while the arrangement is in place, giving breathing room to work through a structured repayment plan. The practice offers a free debt review assessment as a starting point for anyone considering the process. Based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, Debt Success suits individuals under serious financial strain who want a negotiated route back to stability rather than facing creditors alone.

DECOTEQ, in Jan Niemand Park, manufactures DECOTRIM, a lightweight exterior moulding made from EPS polystyrene and hard-coated to withstand the weather, used to decorate building exteriors as crown mouldings, window trims, windowsills, plaster bands, pillar caps and cladding, as well as custom keystones, brackets and props. The material gives a sandstone-like finish while remaining impact resistant, waterproof and easy to install, in flat, curved, concave or convex shapes.

A semi-flexible property lets DECOTRIM move with a building without cracking, and the various densities on offer can be profiled to suit different design briefs, from a stylish window trim on a home to larger architectural features on a commercial building. Based in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, DECOTEQ suits architects, builders and homeowners wanting a durable decorative finish without the weight and cost of natural stone or solid plaster mouldings.

Diep in die Berg, in Wapadrand, combines a restaurant with seven fully equipped conference venues offering uncapped business WiFi, positioning itself for everything from a working conference to a wedding or private function. Visitors have described the setting as a hidden gem, praising the ambience, the efficient and friendly service, and dishes such as sushi served alongside more typical restaurant fare.

The venue markets its conference facilities as a styled, professional setting rather than a bare function room, while its restaurant side focuses on food, atmosphere and consistent service quality. Based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, Diep in die Berg suits businesses needing a conference venue with catering built in, as well as anyone wanting a restaurant that can also host a function without changing location.

Digitize, based in Eco Park, Centurion, offers Digitize OS, an AI-powered business operating platform that connects CRM, project management, a client portal, AI insights and workflow automation in one system rather than several disconnected tools. The platform tracks a business's day-to-day activity through a health score and flags specific opportunities, such as automating lead follow-up, where the business is losing time or money.

Clients move through a three-step process: Discover, where the platform identifies where time, money and opportunities are being lost; Build, where Digitize implements the systems, AI and automation the business needs; and Grow, where the business operates from that connected infrastructure and improves over time. A free, roughly five-minute AI business audit is offered as an entry point. Based in Centurion, Digitize suits small and medium businesses wanting to consolidate scattered systems into one AI-assisted platform rather than adding yet another standalone tool.

Dihlase Consulting Engineers, in Lyttelton, is a professional consulting engineering practice specialising in electrical, mechanical and electronic engineering, evolved from five firms that formed the Conradie & Venter and Dihlase Consulting group. The group's head office has been based in Bloemfontein for the past 60 years, with branch offices, including this one, now operating across five South African provinces.

The firm has been responsible for projects with a total annual value of roughly R400 million, and has won industry recognition including the PMR Africa Diamond Arrow Award for Best Mechanical Engineers in the country. Dihlase has majority black ownership, with shareholders drawn entirely from its own electrical and mechanical engineers and technologists rather than outside investors. Based in Lyttelton, Centurion, Dihlase Consulting Engineers suits clients needing an established, multi-provincial engineering practice with a long institutional track record behind its branch offices.

items.description:
The Ditsong Museum of Military History traces its origins to 1940, when Capt. J. Agar-Hamilton was appointed official historian of the Union Defence Forces and an Historical Research Committee was formed to preserve military documents and memorabilia, laying the groundwork for a museum. What was then the South African National War Museum officially opened on 29 August 1947, with former Prime Minister Field Marshal J.C. Smuts describing it at the opening as a memorial to the country's greatest united wartime effort.

Today the museum forms part of the wider Ditsong Museums of South Africa network, which includes the National Museum of Natural History, the National Museum of Cultural History, the Willem Prinsloo Agricultural Museum, the Sammy Marks Museum, the Tswaing Meteorite Crater, the Pioneer Museum and the Kruger Museum. The site also hosts events and offers virtual museum tours for visitors who cannot make it in person. Based in Saxonwold, Johannesburg, the Ditsong Museum of Military History suits visitors interested in South Africa's military history and the preservation efforts behind it.

Doppio Zero Hazelwood, on Oaktree Avenue, is built around a signature wood-fired oven that gives the restaurant's dishes its distinctive Doppio touch, served alongside relaxed outdoor seating when the weather allows. The branch is set up to welcome families, offering a baby chair and kids menu, and provides wheelchair access through the front entrance, though its restroom facilities are not wheelchair accessible.

Bookings can be made through the Dineplan booking system or by ordering directly via WhatsApp, and the restaurant offers limited on-site parking with additional paid, secured parking available next door for busier periods. Based in Hazelwood, Pretoria, Doppio Zero Hazelwood suits families and casual diners wanting a relaxed, wood-fired menu with straightforward booking and parking options nearby.

Dries du Plessis Signs & Laser Cutting, trading as DuP Projects in Wonderboom South, has built up 26 years of experience in signage, laser cutting and digital printing, visible in how the team manages projects, prepares drawings and resolves faults on site. Its range covers banners, large-format printing, LED strips and modules, laser and CNC cutting, digital printing, Chromadek signage, 3D lettering and custom trophies.

The business has also carved out a niche producing pulpits and plexiglass display cases alongside its more conventional signage work, reflecting a willingness to take on less typical cutting and fabrication jobs. Based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, Dries du Plessis Signs & Laser Cutting suits churches, schools, sports clubs and businesses needing custom cut or printed items beyond standard shopfront signage.

DWH Construction, founded in 1998 and based in Wapadrand, offers turnkey construction and restoration services across the greater Tshwane area, including Centurion, Pretoria and Midrand. The company's work covers new residential housing, home alterations and restorations, plumbing services and building project management, giving it a broader remit than a single-trade contractor.

DWH is a registered member of the National Home Builders Registration Council, and has built up long, trusting relationships with clients over more than two decades in the Pretoria construction market. Based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, DWH Construction suits homeowners planning a renovation or alteration as well as those building a new home who want one accountable contractor managing the whole project.

E Sun SA was established in 2006 in a small Centurion warehouse and has grown into one of Southern Africa's fastest-growing solar solution providers, now headquartered in Pretoria East. The company distributes, installs and maintains solar inverters, including grid-tie, hybrid, single-phase and three-phase models, alongside monocrystalline solar panels and lithium-ion batteries, for both residential and commercial customers.

Its product range draws on established international brands, including SunSynk, Goodwe and Synapse inverters, Canadian Solar and JA Solar panels, and Freedom Won batteries, giving customers a choice of proven components rather than a single house brand. Based in Pretoria East, E Sun SA suits homeowners and businesses looking for a solar installer with an established track record and a selection of recognised component brands to choose from.

Eagle Self Storage has served Pretoria North since 2000, offering unit sizes from a 3x3m half-garage space at R850 a month up to a 6x6m double unit at R2,100 a month, plus 2.4x6m metal shipping containers at R900 a month for tools and sealed storage. Rental is month-to-month with no security deposit beyond a once-off R300 admin fee, and customers use their own lock and key to control access to their unit.

Security includes 24-hour CCTV monitoring and guarded access, a laser-beam perimeter monitored on site, on-site armed response linked to ADT, a single controlled entrance and exit point with vehicle identification at the gate, and owners who live on the property. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, Eagle Self Storage suits households and businesses in Pretoria North wanting flexible, securely monitored storage without a long-term contract.

Eco Plant Pack, based in Akasia, supplies sustainable, FSC-approved kraft paper packaging for the floristry and plant industries, including kraft paper sheets for bouquet wrapping and eco bouquet drop-in sleeves made from high-quality 80gsm paper. Its range also covers kraft pot covers and orchid pot cover drop-in sleeves for indoor plants, giving florists and nurseries an eco-friendly alternative to plastic wrapping.

For larger arrangements and deliveries, the company supplies large orchid carry bags, bouquet drop-in carry bags in several sizes, bouquet carry boxes, posy flower boxes and single rose drop-in sleeves. Based in Rosslyn, Akasia, Eco Plant Pack suits florists, plant nurseries and gift shops wanting packaging that looks good, protects delicate stock and reduces plastic use at the same time.

EKM Exports, based in Hazeldean, is a South African export company built by producers for producers, specialising in the production, procurement and export of fresh produce including its flagship GOGO citrus range alongside table grapes, apples and soft citrus. The company now exports roughly 3 million cartons of produce a year, with its fruit consistently fetching some of the highest prices on competitive international produce markets.

EKM aims to control every link in the value chain itself, from production, packaging and storage through to marketing and logistics, supported by its own GOGO cold rooms, packhouses and logistics operation as well as a related Kholwa Logistics arm. Based in Hazeldean, Pretoria, EKM Exports suits international buyers and retailers wanting a South African supplier that controls its own supply chain from farm to vessel rather than relying on third parties at each stage.

Elliott Attorneys Incorporated, based in Garsfontein, offers a free first consultation and handles opposed, unopposed and settled divorce cases, taking particular care where minor children are involved in a matter. Its family law practice extends to securing contact rights for parents with minor children, always framed around the children's best interests rather than either parent's preference.

Beyond family law, the firm handles civil litigation, commercial drafting and contracts, the drafting of wills, mineral law and mining compliance, criminal law, domestic violence matters and maintenance disputes, giving it a broader general practice alongside its family law work. Based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, Elliott Attorneys Incorporated suits clients going through a divorce or custody matter as well as those needing broader legal support spanning criminal, mining or commercial law.

Emeris Pretoria Campus, in Lynnwood Glen, was formed through the strategic evolution of The IIE's Varsity College, IIE MSA, Vega and the School of Hospitality and Service Management, which united under the single Emeris name. The newly refurbished campus sits in an upmarket residential part of Pretoria, close to shopping, entertainment and transport links, and is a short distance from student accommodation.

The campus serves both local and international students, and offers a virtual campus tour for prospective students who want to see the facilities before applying in person. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, Emeris Pretoria Campus suits school leavers and international students looking for a private higher education campus with a well-established academic lineage behind the Emeris brand.

Envestpro Pretoria, in Erasmuskloof, is a financial planning practice built around an elephant brand symbol representing wisdom, patience and deeply rooted client relationships rather than transactional financial advice. The team positions itself as a long-term partner for milestones such as funding a child's education, planning for retirement or building intergenerational wealth, blending the suburb's sense of heritage and stability with modern financial strategy.

Its core services cover individual risk cover, investments and retirement planning, and the practice is part of a wider Envestpro network with offices in Cape Town, Midrand, Fourways, Umhlanga and Gqeberha. Envestpro also runs a Changing Lives Foundation as part of its community involvement. Based in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, Envestpro Pretoria suits clients wanting an adviser relationship built for the long term rather than a single transactional policy sale.

ET IT Solutions, in Eersterust, has delivered voice, data, cloud and security services to Pretoria businesses since 2012, working with 3CX and Yealink PBX systems and PortaOne voice platforms for business telephony. Its connectivity offering spans business fibre through providers including Seacom, RSAWEB, MetroFibre and Vox Telecoms, business wireless through Comsol, business LTE through MTN, and satellite connectivity through Paratus.

On the cloud and security side, the company supports Ubiquiti UniFi cloud controllers, hosted PBX, Office 365, hosting, domains, VPS and servers, alongside managed DNS, CCTV installation, biometrics, and firewall support using Sophos, Fortigate and Eset products. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:30pm and weekends from 8am to 2pm, ET IT Solutions suits Eersterust and Pretoria businesses wanting a single provider across telephony, connectivity, cloud and network security.

EXZA, based in Kameeldrif East, provides fibre installation, solar installation, communication tower installation, wireless connectivity solutions and cloud services for residential and commercial clients, backed by its own project management for each installation. The company positions its teams as multidisciplinary and skilled professionals able to add value across different types of infrastructure projects rather than specialising narrowly in one.

A downloadable company presentation is available for clients wanting more detail on EXZA's full capability before engaging the team on a project. Based in Kameeldrift, Pretoria, EXZA suits residential estates, businesses and communities needing fibre, wireless, solar or tower installation handled by one contractor rather than separate specialists for each type of infrastructure.

Fortuna Foods, based in Louwlardia, Centurion, supplies fresh, flavour-focused ingredients including garlic, ginger, chillies, pickles and chimichurri, sourced through relationships with premier local and international growers. The company's focus is on turning everyday cooking into something more interesting, aiming to keep words like "bland" and "boring" out of its customers' kitchens.

Its in-house product development team experiments with new combinations of fresh, fragrant spices and flavours for the retail, food service and hospitality trade, with a downloadable product list available for prospective buyers. Fortuna Foods holds its own BBBEE certification. Based in Louwlardia, Centurion, Fortuna Foods suits retailers, restaurants and food businesses wanting speciality fresh flavour ingredients rather than standard bulk produce.

GBM Group of Companies, founded in 1992 in Ashley Gardens, was established by three founding partners who were all qualified chartered accountants with backgrounds at one of the big five international auditing firms before gaining further tax experience at the South African Revenue Service. That combination of big-firm audit training and SARS-side tax experience shaped the practice's consulting-led approach to client work.

The firm offers accounting and bookkeeping, taxation and audit services, along with support managing the paperwork required for business registration, serving clients particularly in Pretoria and Secunda. GBM continues to grow its network by forming associations with other small accounting practices, giving clients access to a wider pool of professional expertise. Based in Ashley Gardens, Pretoria, GBM Group suits businesses wanting a chartered accounting firm with genuine big-firm and SARS-side experience behind it.

items.description:
Gimi Access, based in Pretoria North, manufactures, supplies and installs Tactile Ground and Walking Surface Indicators, holding a flawless record on certified pedestrian ramps backed by a Level 2 BEE rating and a 100% approval guarantee: if a project is disapproved, Gimi Access redoes the work at its own cost. Its products are rated at a 42 MPA strength, exceeding typical industry standards for durability.

The range includes warning and guiding or directional blocks, PRASA warning blocks, buffer blocks, bus stop kerbs with and without channels, transition kerbs, cradle kerbs for bus rapid transport stations, indicator blocks, and imported ceramic or porcelain and stick-on tactile tiles. Based in Amandasig, Pretoria, Gimi Access suits municipalities, contractors and transport authorities needing accessibility infrastructure that meets strict regulatory and durability standards.

Global Visa House, in Celtisdal, Centurion, has spent more than eight years helping travellers apply for tourist, business, student and exchange, and family or transit visas, including Schengen, UK, US and Canadian applications among others. The agency's work covers document preparation, appointment booking, application support and guidance through each embassy's specific requirements.

The company says it has processed more than 5,000 visa applications, offering expert document review, appointment scheduling, application tracking and embassy liaison to reduce the risk of a rejected application. Based in Centurion, Global Visa House suits travellers, students and business applicants who want professional support navigating visa requirements rather than applying entirely on their own.

HDS Waltloo Cut & Edge, part of the HDS Cut & Edge Group, describes itself as the largest board cut-and-edge distributor in Sub-Saharan Africa, supplying raw MDF, chipboard, veneered, foil and high-gloss boards in both UV and acrylic finishes, plywood, post-form and stone tops, and the widest range of melamine-faced boards. Customers can order bulk boards, single sheets, or have boards cut and edged to size in-house.

Its catalogue extends to melamine, gloss, foil and acrylic board ranges, countertops, 3D wall cladding and UV wall panels, alongside general cabinet hardware such as hinges, chrome baskets, bar handles and hanging rails for finishing a project. Based in Waltloo, Pretoria, HDS Waltloo Cut & Edge suits cabinet makers, shopfitters and DIY customers needing boards cut to size alongside the hardware to finish the job.

Inry Pale and Top Thatch, in Annlin West, is a thatching company serving both corporate and private clients on projects including residential homes, game farms, rest camps and international work. The company repairs, re-thatches, maintains and builds new thatch roofs and lapas, and runs its own SABS-standard treating plant for its CCA-treated poles, which the business says keeps its pricing competitive compared with buying pre-treated materials elsewhere.

Beyond thatch roofing itself, Inry Pale and Top Thatch supplies cape reed and thatching grass for anyone building or repairing their own structure, and installs lightning conductors to protect completed thatch roofs from lightning strikes. Based in Annlin West, Pretoria, the company suits homeowners, lodges and game farms needing both the materials and the skilled labour for a thatch roof project.

International Race Supplies, in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, has spent 25 years importing specialised racing and performance components for the motorsport, tuning, military and other industries. Rather than stocking a broad, generic range, the company holds sole distributor arrangements for a focused set of world brands, including AP Racing, Goodridge, PFC Brakes, Firesense, Helix Autosport, MOCAL Oil Control Systems and Lifeline Fire & Safety Systems.

That narrower focus lets the business concentrate on advice, product knowledge and service rather than trying to be all things to all customers, sourcing additional special requirements from its international supplier network where appropriate. Based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, International Race Supplies suits motorsport teams, tuners and defence-industry buyers needing genuine, correctly specified performance parts rather than generic aftermarket substitutes.

Jansen van Rensburg and Partners Inc, founded in 2013 and based in Clubview, Centurion, represents large corporates, entrepreneurs and businesses across their everyday legal challenges, with a proven ability to assist clients remotely and travel wherever a matter requires it despite its single Centurion office. The firm has built a reputation among its peers and the local business community for adapting to client expectations rather than applying a one-size-fits-all service.

Its practice areas include mining and construction law, covering licensing, environmental regulations and labour law issues tied to mining activity as well as construction contracts, permits and disputes, alongside its broader commercial work. Based in Clubview, Centurion, Jansen van Rensburg and Partners suits businesses in the mining and construction sectors as well as general corporate clients needing accessible, partner-level legal attention.

Klagsbrun Edelstein Bosman Du Plessis Inc. (KEBD) is a commercial law firm in Nieuw Muckleneuk serving clients throughout South Africa and abroad, with practice areas spanning corporate and commercial law, tax law, litigation, property law, estates and trusts, and a specific niche in game and agriculture law. The firm frames its approach around an African proverb, "Wisdom is like a baobab tree, no one individual can embrace it," reflecting its emphasis on teamwork over individual stars.

KEBD says its success is defined by its people, pairing recognition of individual strengths with a culture of continued learning, and the firm also invests in the communities where it operates while embracing transformation in South African business. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm, KEBD suits clients needing commercial, tax or property law advice, as well as those in the game and agriculture sector looking for a firm with specific experience in that niche.

La Montagne Day Spa & Beauty Salon, in La Montagne, combines a spa and beauty salon with event space able to host functions, conferences, meetings, anniversaries, birthdays and product launches for up to 40 people standing or 30 seated. Its facilities include an outdoor pool, a dedicated spa or salon area, a whirlpool, and both outdoor and private event spaces, with onsite catering and alcohol permitted for functions.

That combination lets La Montagne host corporate events such as team-building days alongside its core spa treatments, rather than operating purely as a beauty salon. Based in La Montagne, Pretoria, La Montagne Day Spa & Beauty Salon suits both individuals booking a spa treatment and organisers planning a small function or corporate event in a single venue.

items.description:
Leita Steel has been fabricating structural steel in Waltloo since 1968, building a reputation over more than 50 years as one of Africa's leading privately-owned steel fabricators for heavy industrial, mining and commercial projects. Its turnkey offering covers design, detailing, fabrication, corrosion protection, supply and installation, with real-time data capture technology giving clients live status reports on their project.

Products range from aircraft hangars, conveyor steelwork and factories to heavy industrial and mine structures, offices and buildings, plate girders, and plate work such as hoppers, tanks, bins, chutes, launders and hard-wearing liners. Based in Waltloo, Pretoria, Leita Steel suits mining houses, industrial developers and commercial contractors needing a single fabricator able to take a structural steel project from concept through to installation.

Magtran's core business, from its Hennopspark base, is supplying quality transformers, inductors, coils and other magnetic-related products to a wide range of industries. The company relocated to its current Centurion premises in the early 1980s and built its early reputation on quality workmanship and strong customer service, values the business has carried through a change in ownership within the founder's own family.

Magtran works closely with its clients, developing and industrialising new products while taking on client input to improve the value, quality and reliability of its existing range. Based in Hennopspark, Centurion, Magtran suits industrial clients needing custom or standard transformers, inductors and coils from a long-established local manufacturer rather than an imported, off-the-shelf unit.

Mario Motors and Spare Parts, which opened in 2021 on Paul Kruger Street in Mayville, buys and sells used cars and spare parts and stocks new and used batteries, aiming to bring trusted, personally handled automotive servicing to Pretoria motorists at an affordable price. Its spare parts and OEM-quality stock cover the makes South Africans drive daily, including Ford, Volkswagen, Mazda, Mahindra, Kia, Nissan, Haval, Chevrolet, GWM, Opel, Hyundai, Suzuki, Toyota and Datsun.

A dedicated sales team handles enquiries on available cars, pricing and stock, whether a customer is selling a car, buying their next one, or simply maintaining their current vehicle. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:20pm and Saturdays from 8:30am to 2pm, Mario Motors and Spare Parts suits Mayville-area motorists wanting affordable parts, batteries or a used car with a personal touch rather than a large, impersonal dealership.

MaxCool Cooling Solutions, based in Willow Park Manor, designs and builds its cooling equipment in South Africa, led by the MaxCool Omega, a 36-inch mobile evaporative cooler rated by its manufacturer at 23,700 cubic metres of airflow an hour for high-volume spot cooling in suitable ventilated spaces. The Omega is built for hot, open or well-ventilated environments such as factories, workshops, warehouses, hangars, gyms, sports facilities and event venues.

Beyond mobile cooling, the company's locally manufactured MaxCool Breeze HVLS fans improve air circulation and comfort across large industrial and commercial areas, while its rooftop evaporative coolers provide centralised, whole-building cooling. Equipment is available to buy outright or rent on a permanent, seasonal or event basis. Based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, MaxCool Cooling Solutions suits businesses and event organisers needing industrial-scale cooling matched to a specific space and budget.

Maxmo Campers, in Waltloo, builds camper vans on Mercedes-Benz bases across several model lines, including the Mercedes Sporter 4x4 Lifestyle Camper with a north-south queen bed, shower and toilet combo and a 1.9m bicycle storage drawer, and the compact Mercedes Cheetah 6X 4x4 with a rear lounge, queen bed and its own shower and toilet combo. Larger models include the Cheetah 7XL 4x4 Overlander, with a slide-out front lounge, island bed, walk-in RV bathroom and rear garage, and the Cheetah 7X 4x4 Touring Camper.

Each layout is designed around a different travel style, from weekend trips to extended overland touring, with factory visits available by appointment for customers wanting to see a build in progress. Based in Waltloo, Pretoria, Maxmo Campers suits travellers wanting a specific, purpose-built camper layout rather than a generic conversion.

MetQ, in Akasia, was founded in 1979 as MetQuip to address gaps in the mineral processing industry, starting out by developing its own polyurethane spraying equipment to apply a wear-resistant coating capable of reaching 98% density. That technology let MetQ recondition damaged spirals rather than requiring mines to replace them outright, delivering significant cost savings for the mining industry at the time.

More than 40 years later, the company supplies hydrocyclones for mineral processing, the food industry and water treatment, a wide range of spiral configurations, hydrosizers that use the hindered settling principle for efficient classification, modular screen panels, and its own in-house steel fabrication facility. Based in Akasia, Pretoria, MetQ suits mining, food and water treatment operations needing particle-sizing and gravity-concentration equipment from a specialist with a four-decade track record.

items.reason: MTN's own website showed a maintenance notice on every page reached; only generic, national MTN brand information was found, nothing specific to the Wonderpark branch.

items.description:
MTP Security Services, based in Olievenhoutbosch, has operated since 2006 across three divisions: security, transport and construction, responding to client queries seven days a week within 24 hours. The company's mission centres on giving private businesses of all sizes and the public sector a comprehensive, educated understanding of its services, rather than simply selling a guarding contract.

Its vision commits to equal, non-discriminatory service for every client, alongside quick, affordable and reliable protection and after-sales maintenance of installed products. Based in Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion, MTP Security Services suits clients wanting a single provider across guarding, transport and construction-related services rather than a security-only specialist.
